boundary.zh: 本附件为待审协议草案。全部角色待任命，签字为空；合成演练可离线复现，现场服务尚未授权。
boundary.en: This is an unsigned protocol draft. Roles are unappointed and signatures are empty; the synthetic drill can run offline, but field service is not authorized.

input.zh: 经同意且去标识的问题描述、无屏任务
input.en: consented, de-identified questions and screenless tasks

output.zh: 任务卡、沟通障碍记录、同渠道答复
output.en: task card, communication barriers and same-channel reply

retest.zh: 沟通方式或任务版本改变
retest.en: communication method or task version changes

exit.zh: 撤回问题材料、通知受理角色、保留非个人状态记录
exit.en: withdraw question material, notify intake, retain non-personal status

input.zh: 模型版本、许可测试样本和局限
input.en: model version, licensed samples and limitations

output.zh: 失败档案、可复现重测任务
output.en: failure dossier and reproducible retest task

authorization.zh: 模型、样本及发布范围授权

retest.zh: 模型、样本或适用用途改变
retest.en: model, sample or intended purpose changes

exit.zh: 撤销测试许可、失效收据、通知采用端
exit.en: revoke test permission, expire receipts, notify adopters

sender.zh: 候选科研材料保管角色

input.zh: 经许可的仪器说明、出处和解释问题
input.en: licensed instrument notes, provenance and interpretation questions

receiver.zh: 众智园与原点复核角色

output.zh: 证据边界说明、公众解释修订
output.en: evidence limitations and revised public explanation

authorization.zh: 材料用途及公开解释授权

retest.zh: 仪器版本、资料或解释主张改变
retest.en: instrument version, material or claim changes

exit.zh: 停止展示、撤回副本并回送修订通知
exit.en: stop display, withdraw copies and return revision notice

sender.zh: 候选产业场景责任角色

input.zh: 脱敏任务、供应商声明、退出要求
input.en: redacted tasks, supplier claims and exit requirements

receiver.zh: 大钟寺采购与众智园重测角色
receiver.en: Dazhongsi procurement and Zhongzhiyuan retest roles

output.zh: 压力测试档案、采购修订建议、迁移检查单
output.en: stress-test dossier, procurement revision advice and migration checklist

authorization.zh: 企业材料、测试环境和采购用途授权
authorization.en: enterprise material, test-environment and procurement-use permission

retest.zh: 供应商、流程或退出能力改变
retest.en: supplier, process or exit capability changes

exit.zh: 停止采用、隔离样本、撤销接口并核对导出
exit.en: stop adoption, isolate samples, revoke interface and verify export

input.zh: 最小协议、适用边界和失败样例
input.en: minimal protocol, scope limitations and failure examples

receiver.zh: 原点交接与接收地复核角色

output.zh: 迁移差异表、属地复核结果、退出记录
output.en: transfer-difference table, local review result and exit record

authorization.zh: 逐用途许可与属地责任确认
authorization.en: purpose-specific permission and local responsibility confirmation

retest.zh: 接收场地、人群或渠道改变
retest.en: receiving site, population or channel changes

exit.zh: 撤回接口、逐接收方通知，禁止直接搬运个人案件
exit.en: withdraw interface, notify each recipient; no transfer of personal case files

deliverable.zh: 许可、样本版本、用途→最小测试包；撤回即停用样本
deliverable.en: Permission, sample version, purpose → minimal test bundle; withdrawal stops sample use

handover.zh: 隔离环境运维角色→评测角色

deliverable.zh: 环境版本、隔离配置→可复现运行日志；日志缺失不采用
deliverable.en: Environment version, isolation setup → reproducible run log; missing logs block adoption

deliverable.zh: 版本、限制、导出能力→失败档案；版本变化重测
deliverable.en: Version, limits, export capability → failure dossier; version change triggers retest

deliverable.zh: 证据与异议→有期限复核意见；利益冲突需回避
deliverable.en: Evidence and dissent → expiring review; conflicts require recusal

deliverable.zh: 服务与无屏走查→适配及恢复清单；不宣称工程可行
deliverable.en: Service and screenless walkthrough → adaptation and recovery checklist; no engineering approval

handover.zh: 科技服务翼候选角色→采用角色

deliverable.zh: 培训、交接、资源依据→交接单及成本结构；无资金承诺
deliverable.en: Training, handover and resource basis → handover record and cost structure; no funding promise

acceptance.zh: 纸面案件号、材料状态与完整渠道清单
acceptance.en: Paper case ID, material status and complete channel inventory

forbidden.zh: 案件受理人不得自行结案
forbidden.en: The case steward cannot close a case they accepted

acceptance.zh: 逐渠道暂停回执或不可达说明
acceptance.en: Pause acknowledgement or unreachable record for every channel

forbidden.zh: 供应商不得阻止人工暂停；不得绕过暂停直接复核
forbidden.en: A supplier cannot block human pause, and review cannot bypass pause

acceptance.zh: 依据、不确定性、利益冲突与结论或升级路径
acceptance.en: Basis, uncertainty, conflict check and conclusion or escalation

forbidden.zh: 原作者、供应商、渠道或服务责任人不得复核自己
forbidden.en: Authors, suppliers, channel owners and service owners cannot review themselves

acceptance.zh: 逐渠道旧版、新版、时间、责任人和前台签收
acceptance.en: Old/new version, time, owner and front-end acknowledgement per channel

forbidden.zh: 只改后台、漏发或未签收均不得计为完成
forbidden.en: Backend-only changes, omissions or missing acknowledgements never count as complete

acceptance.zh: 失败样例、触发条件、修复版本与重测结果
acceptance.en: Failure fixture, trigger, repaired version and retest result

forbidden.zh: 重测负责人不得自行恢复服务
forbidden.en: The retest lead cannot self-authorize service restoration

work.zh: 采用、限制、暂停续约或退役
work.en: Adopt, restrict, pause renewal or retire

acceptance.zh: 人工作出的采用后果、剩余问题和下次复核日
acceptance.en: Human adoption consequence, remaining issues and next review date

forbidden.zh: 模型不得自动决定继续采用或退役
forbidden.en: A model cannot automatically decide continued adoption or retirement

acceptance.zh: 设备、材料、数据、缓存、备份和空间逐项关闭
acceptance.en: Itemized closure of equipment, material, data, cache, backup and space

forbidden.zh: 未留下恢复证据不得关闭案件
forbidden.en: A case cannot close without recovery evidence

acceptance.zh: 七类凭证齐全、全渠道签收、重测、采用后果与恢复均完成
acceptance.en: Seven receipt classes, all-channel acknowledgement, retest, adoption consequence and recovery complete

forbidden.zh: 任一渠道或恢复事项未闭合时不得CLOSED
forbidden.en: CLOSED is forbidden while any channel or recovery item remains open

independence.zh: 原发布者、供应商、材料制作人、渠道责任人及服务责任人不得担任本案独立复核；利益冲突记录为必填。复核人缺席或结论无法确定时保持暂停并提供人工说明，不自动生成不利结论。
independence.en: The original publisher, supplier, material author, channel owner and service owner cannot independently review their own case. Conflict disclosure is mandatory. Unavailable review or unresolved facts keep the case paused with human explanation, not an automatic adverse finding.

separation_of_duties.rule_zh: 不能自己犯错、自己复核、自己恢复服务；受理、暂停、复核、重测、采用与恢复的权力不可互相替代。
separation_of_duties.rule_en: No actor may cause an error, review it and restore the service alone; intake, pause, review, retest, adoption and recovery authorities are not interchangeable.
separation_of_duties.fail_closed_zh: 角色、签收或恢复证据缺失时保持HOLD或退役，不得以稍后补录为由继续。
separation_of_duties.fail_closed_en: A missing role, acknowledgement or recovery record keeps the case on HOLD or retired; deferred paperwork cannot justify continuation.

channel_rule.zh: 更正覆盖全部已登记原渠道并逐一签收才完成；只改后台、漏发或未签收均保持暂停。渠道清单与签收数不能互相代替。
channel_rule.en: Completion requires correction and acknowledgement on every registered original channel. Backend-only changes, omissions or missing receipts keep service paused. Inventory and acknowledgement counts are not interchangeable.

purpose.zh: 仅支持遗产内容误标的受理、复核、更正和恢复；当前只用合成材料。
purpose.en: Only intake, review, correction and recovery of mislabeled heritage content; current material is synthetic only.

excluded.zh: 不收集人脸、身份证号、健康记录、跨场景画像；联系方式如现场确需使用，须另行授权、隔离保存并提供无联系方式办理路线。
excluded.en: No faces, ID numbers, health records or cross-scenario profiles. Any field contact detail needs separate permission and isolation, with a no-contact-detail service route.

access.zh: 公众可读；不含案件原件或直接标识
access.en: Public; no original case material or direct identifiers

retention.zh: 结案后90天复核公开必要性；属建议周期，非法律期限
retention.en: Review need for publication 90 days after closure; proposed interval, not a legal deadline

access.zh: 仅受理、资料保管和独立复核角色按需访问
access.en: Need-to-know intake, custodian and independent reviewer

retention.zh: 结案且申诉处理完毕后30天内建议删除；现场前由责任人与专业审查确认
retention.en: Proposed deletion within 30 days after closure and completed appeals; owner and professional review must confirm before field use

access.zh: 受限审计；不默认公开个人材料或可关联哈希
access.en: Restricted audit; no default publication of personal material or linkable hashes

retention.zh: 拟每90天审查必要性；最终期限及依据在现场授权前确定
retention.en: Proposed necessity review every 90 days; final duration and basis must be set before field authorization

deletion.zh: 按原件、派生副本、缓存、导出和备份逐项清理或隔离。备份尚未清除不得写“全部删除”；记录计划到期及恢复时再删除要求。保全例外必须记录依据、批准人、复核日及访问限制。
deletion.en: Track originals, derivatives, caches, exports and backups separately. Pending backup removal cannot be called complete deletion; record expiry and re-delete-on-restore controls. Any preservation exception requires basis, approver, review date and restricted access.

impact_checks.zh: 逐项评估错误标签的声誉影响、过度公开、二次传播、复核冲突、拒绝服务和无屏排斥；每项记录控制、剩余风险、责任人和是否可接受。未通过则不开放真实渠道。
impact_checks.en: Assess reputational harm, over-disclosure, secondary propagation, reviewer conflicts, service denial and screenless exclusion. Record controls, residual risk, owner and acceptability for each; no live channels before acceptance.

control.zh: 不利标签暂停；事实、检测及来源分栏；提供申诉
control.en: Pause adverse labels; separate facts, detection and provenance; offer appeal

residual.zh: 已传播的印象不能保证完全消除
residual.en: Prior impressions cannot be guaranteed reversible

control.zh: 公开回执去标识；原件受限；逐渠道更正及撤回通知
control.en: De-identify public receipts; restrict originals; correct each channel and notify withdrawal

residual.zh: 外部截图或转述仍需人工后续处理
residual.en: External screenshots or retellings still require human follow-up

control.zh: 发布者与供应商回避；无独立复核不得继续
control.en: Publisher and supplier recusal; no continuation without independent review

residual.zh: 合格独立人员尚待任命

control.zh: 无账户无手机受理、纸面回执、辅助沟通共测
control.en: No-account/no-phone intake, paper receipts and assisted-communication co-tests

residual.zh: 场地与实际用户尚待测试
residual.en: Site and actual-user testing remain pending

control.zh: 分类保留、受限保全例外、备份清理台账及复核日期
control.en: Classified retention, restricted preservation exceptions, backup ledger and review dates

residual.zh: 备份未关闭时不能宣称完全删除
residual.en: No complete-deletion claim while backup actions remain open

consent.zh: 经同意自愿参与，可随时停止；不要求披露诊断，不默认录音录像；退出不影响服务。
consent.en: Voluntary informed participation, stoppable at any time; no diagnosis disclosure or default recording; withdrawal does not affect service.

tasks.zh: 无手机完成受理和纸面回执；低视力读出状态及限制；轮椅路线从入口到私密复核和离开；通过易读或辅助沟通解释“来源有效≠事实真实”。
tasks.en: Complete intake and paper receipt without a phone; read status and limits with low vision; follow wheelchair route from entrance through private review to exit; explain provenance versus truth using easy-read or assisted communication.

acceptance.zh: 同一决定、申诉及更正权利；发现核心任务无法完成即修改后重测。此为共测计划，不是建筑无障碍合规认证。
acceptance.en: Equivalent decision, appeal and correction rights; blocked core tasks require revision and retesting. This is a co-test plan, not built-environment accessibility certification.

method.zh: request_at → human_accept_at；失败和未接管单列
method.en: request_at → human_accept_at; failures and unaccepted cases reported separately

method.zh: 人工更正决定→最后一个原渠道签收；分母为全部登记原渠道
method.en: correction decision → last original-channel acknowledgement; denominator is all inventoried original channels

method.zh: 按沟通方式分别报告完成/尝试数、退出及所需协助；不删失败样本
method.en: report completed/attempted tasks, withdrawals and assistance by communication mode; retain failures

method.zh: 已决定申诉中改判数/已决定申诉数；未结案另列
method.en: reversals/decided appeals; pending cases reported separately

method.zh: 能解释来源不等于真相的人数/同意回答人数；注明未答
method.en: correct explanations of provenance vs truth/consenting respondents; show nonresponses

method.zh: 有证据关闭项/全部应恢复项；备份与场地分开
method.en: evidence-closed recovery items/all required items; separate backups and site

rule.zh: 采用须完成授权、复核、全部渠道更正、重测及恢复并签字；可修复问题选修改并保持暂停；不可恢复或授权撤销选退役。最终CLOSED还必须具备七类运行凭证、全渠道前台签收、产品重测、采用后果和恢复记录。草案空签字不阻断提案讨论，但禁止现场采用。
rule.en: Adoption requires authorization, review, all-channel correction, retest, recovery and signatures. Repairable issues mean modify while paused; irrecoverable issues or withdrawn permission mean retire. Final CLOSED status additionally requires seven operating receipt classes, front-end acknowledgement on every channel, product retest, an adoption consequence and recovery evidence. Empty draft signatures do not block proposal discussion but prohibit field adoption.

action.zh: 确认实名运营主体、场地许可、人员时段及经审查的数据规则；否则只保留合成演练
action.en: Confirm named operator, site permission, staffing hours and reviewed data rules; otherwise remain synthetic only

action.zh: 九个GeoJSON、指标、五组图、HTML及PDF联动复算，记录来源版本、公式和差异
action.en: Recompute nine GeoJSON layers, metrics, five paired figures, HTML and PDFs; preserve source versions, formulas and differences

action.zh: 取得权属、建筑、结构、消防、无障碍与工程数量及成本依据
action.en: Obtain ownership, building, structural, fire, accessibility, quantity and cost evidence

resource_rule.zh: 维持S/M/L档位。成本结构为人员工时×有依据单价＋适配工程量×单价＋设备＋独立复核＋无障碍共测＋恢复与运维；数量、单价、总额均待确认，不据此承诺投资。
resource_rule.en: Retain S/M/L bands. Cost structure: staff hours × sourced rates + adaptation quantities × rates + equipment + independent review + accessibility co-test + recovery and operation. Quantities, rates and totals remain pending; no investment promise.

proposed_slot.zh: 单次60分钟合成演练；现场时段待场地确认
proposed_slot.en: One 60-minute synthetic drill; field opening hours pending host confirmation

spaces.zh: 无屏受理台、等候及纸面回执位
spaces.en: Screenless counter, waiting and paper-receipt position

equipment.zh: 纸面案件卡、可替换展签、离线网页终端；不采集身份材料
equipment.en: Paper case card, replaceable label, offline terminal; no identity-material collection

proposed_slot.zh: T+20至T+60为合成脚本时刻，非真实服务承诺
proposed_slot.en: T+20 to T+60 are synthetic script moments, not live service promises

spaces.zh: 私密复核、受控重测、退出与恢复位
spaces.en: Private review, controlled retest, exit and recovery positions

equipment.zh: 许可材料清单、版本日志、隔离存储、恢复检查表
equipment.en: Permission inventory, version log, isolated storage and recovery checklist

state.zh: 包内来源与许可可核对；不认证其他未提供材料
state.en: Packaged sources/licences can be checked; no certification of unsupplied material

state.zh: 已有草案，未获现场专业批准
state.en: Draft exists; no field professional approval

state.zh: 回避规则可审查；具体人员待任命
共测任务及记录表已设计；现场未测
state.en: Co-test tasks and records designed; no field testing

state.zh: 签字空白，禁止现场采用；不阻断提案讨论
state.en: Signatures empty: no field adoption; proposal discussion remains possible
